examples.english: Moses led the people from the camp to meet Our Lord, and they stood at the foot of the mountain, Mount Sinai.

examples.text: Et a tal uertud que ſi la ponẽ ſobre mill peſos de pez faz los feruir por ſu p̃p̃dat biẽ como si estudieſſen a fuego.
